## Quelaunt (CR 15)

**XP** 51,200  
CE Large aberration  
**Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., Perception +32, tremorsense 60 ft.  


**Defense**


**AC** 30, touch 20, flat-footed 24 (+5 Dex, +1 dodge, +10 natural, +5 profane, -1 size)  
**hp** 276 (23d8+92)  
**Fort** +13, **Ref** +12, **Will** +19; +5 vs. mind-influencing effects  
**DR** 15/magic; **SR** 26  
**Defensive Abilities** emotional void  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft., air walk  
**Melee** 3 claws +22 (3d8+6 plus spiral of despair)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft.  
**Special Attacks** feed on emotion  
**Spell-like Abilities** CL 15th, concentration +24 (+28 casting defensively)  

Constant—air walk  
At will—delusional pride (DC 21), hideous laughter (DC 21), reckless infatuation (DC 22), unadulterated loathing (DC 22)  
3/day—quickened crushing despair (DC 23), fear (DC 23), malicious spite (DC 23), terrible remorse (DC 23)  
1/day—overwhelming presence (DC 25), utter contempt (DC 25)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 23, **Dex** 21, **Con** 19, **Int** 20, **Wis** 22, **Cha** 28  
**Base Atk** +17; **CMB** +24; **CMD** 40 (42 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Combat Casting, Combat Reflexes, Critical Focus, Dazzling Display, [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Exhausting Critical, Fatiguing Critical, Great Fortitude, Improved Critical (claw), Quicken SLA (crushing despair), Shatter Defenses, Weapon Focus (claw)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +31, Bluff +32, Intimidate +35, Knowledge (arcana, planes) +28, Knowledge (dungeoneering) +31, Perception +32, Sense Motive +29, Stealth +27  
**Languages** Aklo (cannot speak), telepathy 100 ft.  
**SQ** no breath, planar acclimation  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** solitary or torment (2-6)  
**Treasure** standard  


**Special Abilities**


**Emotional Void (Su)** A quelaunt adds its Intelligence modifier as a profane bonus to Armor Class and to saves against mind-influencing effects.  

**Feed on Emotion (Su)** As a swift action, a quelaunt can tap into the mind of a creature within 30 feet suffering from a harmful emotion effect. The target takes 4d10 damage and is stunned 1 for 1 round; a successful DC 25 Will save reduces the damage by half and negates the stunning effect. If the target fails its save, the quelaunt heals the amount of hit points it deals in damage with this ability. This is a mind-influencing effect, and the save DC is Constitution based.  

**Planar Acclimation (Ex)** A quelaunt is always considered to be on its home plane.  

**Spiral of Despair (Su)** A creature hit with a quelaunt’s claw attack must succeed a DC 25 Will save or lose the effect of all beneficial emotional effects for 1 minute. This is a mind-influencing emotion effect, and the save DC is Constitution based.  


**About**
